# Run book: Compare sentence embedding models

[Run books](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/compare-embedding-models.md) | [Spec](../specs/compare-embedding-models.md)

## Contents

- [Purpose](#purpose)
- [Preconditions](#preconditions)
- [Verify](#verify)
- [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)

## Purpose

Models are registered side by side under keys, so switching or comparing models is a change of key, not of code.

## Preconditions

- Each model downloads once into the shared hub cache, so the first use of a model needs internet.

## Verify

Automatically: `npx playwright test e2e/journeys.spec.ts -g "Compare sentence embedding models"` (add `E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8088` to run against the compose stack).

By hand, in the example web application at `/ai/model-compare`:

1. **Score the sample sentences.** Two similar sentences are filled in with the first model ticked. Score them. Expect: A table shows the model, its vector size, the similarity and the time taken.

## Troubleshooting

**Table 1 — Known problems**

| Symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Score is disabled | A text is empty or no model is ticked | Fill in both texts and tick at least one model |
| A model fails on first use | The model files could not be downloaded | Provide internet access once, or copy the files into the shared hub cache folder |

Related framework features: OoBDev.SBert.AllMiniLmL6V2; OoBDev.SBert.AllMpnetBaseV2; OoBDev.SBert.NomicEmbedTextV1_5; OoBDev.Onnx.SentenceEmbeddings.
